_meta.what_this_is: A ledger of a live eval run on a schedule. Each week the harness runs the SAME 50-task suite against the current production model and appends one row: the date, the task count, and how many passed. The question a scheduled eval exists to answer: did the agent quietly get worse? Weeks 1-6 are a stable baseline; a model swap on week 7 drops the true pass rate, and the rows after it are the regression the alarm must catch without firing on the baseline's ordinary wobble.
_meta.results_are: A FIXTURE standing in for twelve weeks of real scheduled runs. Hand-authored so the baseline wobbles inside its noise band (no true change) and the post-swap weeks sit below it (a real ~16-point regression). Point the chart at your own dated runs.
_meta.regression_weeks: 07..12, true pass rate ~0.61 after a model swap
